description: GESTIÓN DEL RIESGO is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Ministerio de Defensa Nacional - MinDefensa, Bogotá D.C.. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Defensa Nacional - MinDefensa, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are gestión del riesgo, observatoriomdn. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Seguridad y Defensa. The portal shows 2026-08-18 as the last update.
